[Day 1 in London – Intern Week with Schroders Greencoat Capital!]

Welcome to Ballymahon Vocational Schools website. I sincerely hope that your visit to this site will be enjoyable and will provide all the information you require about our college and the services and facilities we offer. As Principal, I wish to extend a warm welcome to all our students, in particular though our new first year students, international students and other students who have enrolled for the first time in the school. I join with the very dedicated staff in St. Paul’s Community Colle

We are thrilled to announce that Ballymahon Vocational School has officially been recognised as an ADHD Friendly School by ADHD Ireland, and the first school in County Longford to achieve this accreditation. This accreditation highlights our ongoing commitment to inclusive education and ensuring that every student feels supported and empowered. This initiative has been led out by Ms. Caroline Corkery and Ms. Denise Smyth.
